title: Buğu
author: Nihan Kaya
description: This is a journey to the inner world of a child who grew up under the shadow of her family. The readers will find themselves facing with repressed memories, unspoken emotions and the deep loneliness of a child. How is a child's naive perception and vulnerability shaped in a world full of secrets kept hidden by adults? How is the search for love, trust and identity kneaded with the traces of the past? This novel deals with the complex structure of the family through the eyes of a child, and depicts the fine line between love and violence, and the individual's struggle for self-realization. Kaya strikingly reveals the weight of the past and how this weight shapes one's identity.
